## Notes

- Axis Replacement Pool (SPI 20.66), three charts on one page of the Axis chart set (jp2 175): 20.66a Axis Truck Production Chart, the German Production Chart and the Italian Production Chart. Per type: lifetime total, the cap per turn / month / fortnight for each dated period, the first (and last) game-turn it may be planned for, and the naval convoy tonnage per point. Points arrive two game-turns after planning (Tunis-box items excepted). A period with its own total is the chart's second Number: the first Number is the ceiling during its dates and the sum is the ceiling overall
- Item slugs are ours. The German chart's '2.8cm s.Pz.B.41 / 28/20 Pak' pair is one item (2-8cm-spzb41); the Italian chart's group headings are the group field
- Printed as in 1979: the Italian chart's closing note names the M 13/39 as having no replacements; SPI's September 1979 errata (E-014) says M 11/39 — applied as the overlay data/errata/E-014.json
- Transcribed from the archive.org scan and cross-checked against the 300 dpi community scan (scan:discord:Axis Charts.pdf:p33): 0 of 3 truck rows, 0 of 23 German rows and 0 of 20 Italian rows differ. Clay Stone's errata-integrated Land rules PDF contains no charts
